title: Creating a Plugin
one_liner: A plugin is a directory with a manifest at .claude-plugin/plugin.json and components at the plugin root. Load it with --plugin-dir while developing.

core.title: Layout: manifest inside, components outside
core.body: Only `plugin.json` goes in `.claude-plugin/`. Skills, agents, hooks and MCP config sit at the plugin root.
core.why: Components placed inside `.claude-plugin/` do not load.

quotes.text: Only `plugin.json` goes inside `.claude-plugin/`. Components saved there don't load.
quotes.label: Create a plugin > Plugin layout

core.title: The manifest name becomes a prefix
core.body: `name` is required in `plugin.json`. Plugin skills and agents are namespaced, for example `/my-plugin:hello`.
core.why: Two plugins can ship a `hello` skill without colliding, but users must type the prefix.

quotes.text: It identifies the plugin and becomes the prefix on every skill and agent the plugin provides.
quotes.label: Create a plugin > Write the manifest

quotes.text: so two plugins can each provide a `hello` skill without colliding
quotes.label: Create a plugin > Decide when to use a plugin

core.title: Develop without a marketplace
core.body: `claude --plugin-dir ./my-plugin` loads the plugin for one session without installing it. `claude plugin init <name>` scaffolds a plugin in `~/.claude/skills/` that loads every session.
core.why: No publishing step is needed to iterate.

quotes.text: which loads a plugin for one session without installing it
quotes.label: Create a plugin > First plugin

core.title: Validate, reload, inspect
core.body: Run `claude plugin validate <path>` before loading. After edits, `/reload-plugins` in the session. The `/plugin` **Errors** tab shows what failed to load.
core.why: Most failures are a wrong path or malformed frontmatter, and these checks find them quickly.

quotes.text: Check the manifest and the skill's frontmatter before you run anything
quotes.label: Create a plugin > Validate

quotes.text: run `/reload-plugins` to apply edits you made on disk
quotes.label: Create a plugin > Test and debug

practice.title: Build a one-skill plugin
practice.goal: Learn the layout and the namespace.
steps: Write `skills/hello/SKILL.md` with a `name`, `description` and one instruction
practice.check: Validation passes and Claude replies with a greeting.
practice.variation: Move `skills/` inside `.claude-plugin/` and check the **Errors** tab.

practice.title: Scaffold a persistent plugin
practice.variation: Disable it with `claude plugin disable my-tool@skills-dir`.

gotchas: `--plugin-dir` must point at the plugin root, not a marketplace root.
A `.mcp.json` saved at `~/.claude/.mcp.json` does not load as part of a plugin.
Without a manifest, `--plugin-dir` names the plugin after its directory.
The root skill of a `claude plugin init` plugin runs as `/my-tool`, not `/my-tool:my-tool`.
